## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain unavailable database/GUI checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change with relevant tests and documentation.
- [ ] No credentials, database dumps, private keys or personal data.
- [ ] SQL values are bound and engine-specific identifiers are quoted.
- [ ] Keyboard access is provided for new UI actions.
- [ ] Storage/transaction/security changes include failure-path coverage.
- [ ] Third-party code/assets have their source and license recorded.
